cancelled_withdrawal_amount.meaning: _cancelledWithdrawalAmount HYPE value recorded when a user cancels a withdrawal request
cancelled_withdrawal_amount.checkpoint: before redelegateWithdrawnHYPE reads and resets it

redelegated_amount.meaning: amount actually re-delegated via _distributeStake SpotDeposit after truncating conversion

caller_has_manager_role.meaning: caller of redelegateWithdrawnHYPE holds MANAGER_ROLE privileges

assumptions: The re-delegation is expected to preserve the full cancelled withdrawal amount; the report's intent states the amount % 1e10 remainder should be retained in hypeBuffer or otherwise accounted for rather than lost.
cancelled_withdrawal_amount is a nonnegative HYPE value in wei.

unresolved.description: The conservation relation requires redelegated_amount == cancelled_withdrawal_amount, but the report states the conversion truncates by amount / 1e10 with roundUp false and drops amount % 1e10; the exact post-state accounting location (hypeBuffer vs elsewhere) is unspecified, so the retained-remainder side cannot be bound to a concrete storage symbol.

limitations: The impact magnitude is bounded only as less than 1e10 wei (less than 1e-8 HYPE) per call; no concrete cancelled_withdrawal_amount value is given.
The report does not specify whether the lost remainder is stranded in an ETH balance or an L1 account; only the per-call loss relation is formalized here.
Other impacts (outside accounting, permanent stranding, diminished kHYPE profits) are not formalized by this plan.
